# Margin · 页边

> Independent local manual-review workspace for Markdown and LaTeX. Authors
> read, annotate, revise and exchange portable review packages. No built-in AI.

Node.js 20+, one runtime library (KaTeX), no browser bundler. Optional Electron
desktop shell. No login, model ID or API key. New project data uses `.margin.json`
and `.margin/`; old packages remain importable for migration.
